text_block_list.text:
Inari One emerged victorious in the Tokyo 
Daishoten, standing at the "top" of the 
regional circuit. Cheers of "Inari!" 
resonated throughout the racecourse.

Meanwhile, Inari One declares to the crowd 
that she will reach the very top in the 
Central league as well, and become the 
"Umamusume of the Year."

In the stands, Oguri Cap and Super Creek 
take that as a message aimed at them, 
feeling their competitive spirits ignite.

The first target in the Senior Year is the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). She advanced along her 
brawling journey toward the next festival 
stage: the Central GⅠ frontlines.
